Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#2224` reports that chat({ reasoning }) is dropped for claude-opus-5-5 because the id is missing from CLAUDE_CODE_REASONING. The expected result is --effort high for claude-opus-5-5. The whole-PR diff of packages/ai-claude-code/src/model-meta.ts adds claude-opus-5-5, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-1 to CLAUDE_CODE_MODELS. The same diff maps each id to EFFORT_LOW_TO_MAX in CLAUDE_CODE_REASONING, so resolveReasoning no longer returns undefined for these ids. The whole-PR diff of packages/ai-claude-code/src/adapters/text.ts adds haiku-5 to the EFFORT_MODELS pattern, so claude-haiku-5-5 receives --effort rather than a thinking-token budget. The added test in tests/reasoning-options.test.ts covers the ids and the high to --effort high mapping. The test run results are author-reported; I did not run the tests. The coding requirement is met by the reviewed code.

**Explanation** Every whole-PR change relates to the Claude 5 reasoning objective. model-meta.ts adds the model ids and their reasoning mapping. text.ts adds haiku-5 to EFFORT_MODELS, which the objective needs for Haiku 5.5. It also rewrites the EFFORT_MODELS comment to match the new behaviour. This is a documentation-only change tied to the same code. The test file checks the new ids. The docs change lists the Claude 5 models and their effort levels. The changeset records the patch release. The omission of off is stated in the PR description and matches the 4.7/4.8 effort entries.
